place: Behind the Kokiri Shop, Kokiri Forest
hint: Find the patch of soft soil at the back of the shop and let a bug loose on it to draw the Skulltula out.

place: House of the Twins, Kokiri Forest
hint: After dark it clings to the Twins' house in the south-east of the village. Pull yourself over with the Hookshot.
At night, check the back wall of the house at the far west side of the village.
In the room that holds the Compass, raise the platforms and cross to the left-hand area; it's on the wall there.
note: The guide leaves the items field blank for this entry.

hint: Fall through the web in the main chamber, then face the vines that lead back up. It's just overhead.

place: Grate by the torch, Deku Tree
hint: Look for a grate next to a torch and some webbing. Jump-attack it, or shoot it with the Slingshot.
In the room where three Gohma Larvae drop in, burn the left-hand web, then go through the short tunnel to the vines.

place: Lone tree west of the Kokiri Forest exit
hint: Coming out of Kokiri Forest, head for the solitary tree to the west and roll into it to knock the Skulltula down.

place: Grotto south-east of Lon Lon Ranch
hint: Bomb the cracked ground south-east of the ranch. Clear the ordinary Skulltula inside as a child first; back as an adult, a wooden box there holds the gold one.

place: Grotto south of Lon Lon Ranch
hint: Further south of the ranch, bomb another cracked patch and drop in. Beat the big Skulltula, then look up the wall.
note: The token is up on a wall; the guide lists only Bombs, so you may want a ranged item to reach it.

hint: Among the pots at the far end of the guard house, one of two boxes is wobbling. Roll into it.

place: Tree by the moat vines, Hyrule Castle
hint: On the way to wake Talon with the Cucco egg, roll into the tree to the right of the vines that lead down to the moat.

place: Lone tree near Talon, Hyrule Castle
hint: Play the Song of Storms by the lone tree just before Talon's spot. The flower patch on the ground opens into a hole with the Skulltula.
At night, walk around the building site in the middle of the village.
At night it sits on the front wall of the House of Skulltula.

place: Tree by the village entrance, Kakariko Village
hint: At night, roll into the lone tree near the village entrance.
At night it's on the ladder of the watchtower near the Death Mountain gate. Shoot it down with the Slingshot.

place: House by the Death Mountain Trail gate, Kakariko Village
hint: At night, check the side wall of the north-west house beside the gate up to Death Mountain Trail.

place: Cliff above Impa's House, Kakariko Village
hint: Hookshot up the vines left of Impa's House and get onto the roof. At night it's on the cliff nearby; Hookshot it from there.
Turn left just inside the graveyard and drop a bug on the mound of soft soil.
At night it hides behind Dampé's hut. Fetch the token with the Boomerang.

place: Building left of the entrance, Lon Lon Ranch
hint: Entering the ranch at night, look at the wall of the building on your left. Boomerang it as a child or Hookshot it as an adult.
In the storage shed where the Piece of Heart is, it's up on the vines. Use the Boomerang.

place: Garden behind the buildings, Lon Lon Ranch
hint: From the entrance take the left path around the buildings to the garden at the back, then roll into the thin tree.
Glide down with a Cucco to the ledge by the waterfall where a Gerudo looks after a cow, then drop a bug on the soil to the left.
note: The guide calls this area "Gerudo Desert". It suggests cutting grass and bushes around Lon Lon Ranch for bugs.

place: Under the wooden bridge, Gerudo Valley
hint: At night, just inside the valley, drop down beneath the wooden bridge. It's on the wall; use the Boomerang.
note: The guide's location tag doesn't say Night, but its directions say to come at night.

place: Behind the carpenters' house, Gerudo Valley
hint: At night, look at the back wall of the carpenters' house and Longshot it.

place: Rocks south of the carpenters' house, Gerudo Valley
hint: South of the carpenters' house, look up at the rocks above you and Longshot it.

place: Soft soil by the Lakeside Laboratory
hint: Release a bug onto the soft soil beside the Lakeside Laboratory.
At the far south of the lake, a small ledge has a hole into the cliff. Crawl through as a child to reach it.
At night it's on the outside of the Lakeside Laboratory. Grab it with the Boomerang.
note: The guide's location tag doesn't say Night, but its directions say to come at night.

hint: The Longshot lets you reach the top of the dead trunk on the lake's central island, where it waits.

place: Past the Skull Kid, Lost Woods
hint: Go left from the entrance, then left again in the Skull Kid's clearing. Drop a bug in the soft soil of the next area.
From the entrance go right, left, right, left, left to the clearing with two Business Scrubs, and drop a bug in its soft soil.

place: Bean plant, Business Scrub clearing, Lost Woods
hint: In that same Business Scrub clearing, plant a Magic Bean as a child. Come back as an adult and ride the plant up to it.
Drop a bug into the soft-soil patch beside Dodongo's Cavern's mouth.

place: Cracked wall on the lower trail
hint: Once you have bombs, blow open the cracked wall on the trail close to Kakariko.
From the summit where Biggoron sits, hop down and smash the dark boulder on the left with the Megaton Hammer.
Another dark boulder, just by the Goron City doorway, hides one. Break it with the Hammer.
Take the main hall's south-east door. In the passage beyond, coax a Baby Dodongo over to the cracked right-hand wall so its blast opens it.
note: Bombs are optional: a Baby Dodongo can open the wall instead.

hint: Climb to the top of the big staircase room and go round to a wall grate. Shoot the Skulltula with the Slingshot, then climb up for the token.

place: Round room with two Dodongos, Dodongo's Cavern
hint: Near the top, before you bomb the statue's eyes, a round room with two Dodongos has one behind its central pillar.

place: Round chamber past the statue, Dodongo's Cavern
hint: Go through the statue's mouth and round the next room to another round chamber. Clear the Baby Dodongos and Armos; it's on the wall.
As an adult, go back to the corridor with the cracked wall. Play the Scarecrow's Song by the raised ledge and Hookshot up to it.
note: The guide lists only the Scarecrow's Song; its directions also use the Hookshot.

hint: Blast through the boulder-filled room with bombs. At the back, by two small chests, roll into the wooden crate.

place: Ceiling near the entrance, Goron City
hint: From the city entrance head north, then turn back the way you came. It's on the ceiling; use the Hookshot.
At the top of the mountain, enter the crater through the opening right of the Fairy cave. One of the two crates on the left holds it.

place: Soft soil by the Fire Temple entrance
hint: Drop a bug into the soft soil at the Fire Temple entrance.

place: Soft soil by the bean seller, Zora's River
hint: Let a bug loose on the soft soil next to the man selling Magic Beans.
At night, at the end of the river, it clings to the side of a platform. Take it out with the Boomerang.

place: High cliff near the river's base
hint: At night, look high up the cliff near the lower end of the river and Hookshot it.

place: High wall near the Zora's Domain entrance
hint: At night, look high up at the river's source by the entrance to Zora's Domain, and Hookshot it.

place: Near the King's throne, Zora's Domain
hint: Once the Domain is frozen, look high up close to the King's throne room and Hookshot it.

place: Thin tree, south end of Zora's Fountain
hint: Roll into the slender tree at the south end of the fountain.
At night, climb the nearby ruins and Boomerang the one on the cliff south of Jabu-Jabu.

place: Top of the boulder path, Zora's Fountain
hint: Lift the huge boulder at the back of the fountain with the Gauntlets and climb up. The Lens of Truth shows hidden Skulltulas on the way; the gold one is at the top.
In the room where you stomp a switch to raise the water, climb the vines to the platform on the left.

place: Ruto's drop room, north wall, Jabu-Jabu's Belly
hint: In the room where Princess Ruto falls through the floor, Boomerang the one on the north wall.

place: Ruto's drop room, north-west tunnel, Jabu-Jabu's Belly
hint: Same room: another hangs from the ceiling of the tunnel to the north-west. Boomerang it too.

place: Vine pillar before the boss, Jabu-Jabu's Belly
hint: On the way to the boss, a tall vine-covered pillar has one near the top. Boomerang it, or shoot it with the Slingshot and climb.
Coming from town into the castle grounds, keep right. At night one is up on the ruins; Hookshot it.
note: The guide files this under Ganon's Castle, but it's on the grounds outside, not inside the dungeon.

hint: Work up through the meadow's maze to its upper end; it's on a wall on the right-hand side. Hookshot it.
note: The guide calls this area "Sacred Forest Grove".

hint: In the entrance area, it's at the top of the vines on the right. Hookshot it.
In the main hall, it's on the back wall. Hookshot it.
In the north-west courtyard with the pools, it's on the south wall. Hookshot it once you're close enough.
In the north-east courtyard with the moat, use the Scarecrow's Song to get up to the east ledge where it waits.
In the final room ahead of the boss, rotate the middle pillar so different alcoves open up. It's in the southernmost alcove.

place: Lava room, north-east passage, Fire Temple
hint: In the big lava chamber on 1F, head north and play the Song of Time to open the north-east passage. Dodge the flying tiles inside.
note: The guide labels this entry "Fire Cavern"; it is in the Fire Temple. The guide lists no items, but its directions use the Song of Time.

hint: In the rolling-boulder room, blow up the north-east wall with a bomb and finish it off in the little alcove behind.
note: The guide labels this entry "Fire Cavern"; it is in the Fire Temple. The guide lists no items, but its directions use bombs.

place: Boulder room, Scarecrow spot, Fire Temple
hint: Also in the boulder room, play the Scarecrow's Song at the swirl to call Pierre, Hookshot up, ride the lift and climb the vines.
note: The guide labels this entry "Fire Cavern"; it is in the Fire Temple. The guide lists only the Scarecrow's Song; its directions also use the Hookshot.

hint: On 5F, in the Megaton Hammer's room, Hookshot the one on the wall.
note: The guide labels this entry "Fire Cavern"; it is in the Fire Temple.

place: First floor north-west room, Fire Temple
hint: Back on the first floor, use the Hammer to get into the north-west room. Avoid the flying tiles, beat the Like Like, then take it.
note: The guide labels this entry "Fire Cavern"; it is in the Fire Temple.

hint: Where the spinning blade circles the room, Hookshot the one on the wall.

place: End of the east passage, Ice Cavern
hint: Follow the eastern passage to its very end; it's on the wall there.
In the sliding-block room it's on the ceiling, so you need the Hookshot.
Put on the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the lab's pool, then roll into the wooden crate.
note: The guide recommends wearing the Zora Tunic for this one.

hint: Sink to the basement with the Iron Boots and find the small chamber to the east. Hookshot the one on the wall.

place: Inside the central pillar, Water Temple
hint: With the water low and the central pillar open, go inside and Longshot up to the highest ceiling point, then Longshot the Skulltula.

place: Second floor east room, Water Temple
hint: Set the water level so you can reach the second floor, then blow open the cracked wall to the eastern room (a Bombchu works best). It's inside.
After Dark Link, walk the whirlpool river in Iron Boots. About halfway along, Hookshot the one on the wall while underwater.
Shortly before the Boss Key, a small corridor has a waterfall hiding it. Hookshot it and watch for the rolling boulders.

place: Lower east room, Bottom of the Well
hint: Take the north-east passage to the eastern chamber and head down a level. Deal with the Like Like there, then Boomerang the token.

place: Central chamber, first locked door, Bottom of the Well
hint: Walk the outer corridor to an alcove the Lens of Truth reveals; its chest has a Small Key. Use it on one of the two doors in the central chamber.

place: Central chamber, second locked door, Bottom of the Well
hint: Swim to the western chamber and burn the coffin at the far end with a Deku Stick to get another key. Open the other central door with it.
In the eight-sided room, it's sitting on the floor.
Use the Lens of Truth to find your way to a room on the east side, where it waits.
In the corridor with the big fans, look down between the platforms and Longshot it. Don't get blown off.
Where spikes drop from the ceiling, circle to the north edge and Longshot it.

place: Scarecrow by the lift, Shadow Temple
hint: Before boarding the boat, play the Scarecrow's Song by the elevator to summon Pierre, then Longshot up to it.
At night, go into the archery range and head all the way down. Look up at the target and Longshot it.

place: Top of the fortress, Gerudo's Fortress
hint: At night, climb up onto the fortress roof; it's on a wall. Longshot it.

place: Below the desert structure, Haunted Wasteland
hint: Follow the flags across the desert until you reach a structure. Go below, climb down the ladder, and it's on the wall.
note: The guide calls this area "Mirage Desert".

place: Soft soil by the Spirit Temple, Desert Colossus
hint: As a child, let a bug loose on the soil patch beside the Spirit Temple doors.
Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil as a child. Come back as an adult and ride the plant until it drops you on the Skulltula's platform.
note: The guide calls this area "Evil Desert Colossus".

hint: It's on the cliff face at the Colossus's northern edge; Longshot it.

place: Past the child crawlspace, Spirit Temple
hint: After the child-sized crawlspace, go through the right-hand door. It's up on a grate to the right; Boomerang it.
In the big statue chamber, go to the north-east corner at ground level. It's tucked behind the statue.

place: Corridor before the Iron Knuckle, Spirit Temple
hint: In the corridor just before the Iron Knuckle fight, turn around and Boomerang the one above you.
In the rolling-boulder room, play the Song of Time to clear the Time Block in an alcove and defeat the Skulltula behind it.

place: North-west platform, statue chamber, Spirit Temple
hint: In the statue chamber, aim for the north-west platform: play the Scarecrow's Song to call Pierre and Longshot up.
